title: Shared Type Definitions
description: Value types reached by $ref from the sibling schemas. Validates nothing on its own, so no document points its $schema here. A name is plain when the type is generic and tool-prefixed when its rule comes from one tool.

nonEmptyString.description: Text that is not empty and has no leading or trailing whitespace.

tag.description: Tag or label. Commas and leading and trailing whitespace are rejected.

windowsAbsolutePath.description: Absolute Windows path: starts with a %VAR% reference, a drive root (C:\ or C:/), or a UNC share (\\server\share). A relative path is rejected because the consuming script's working directory is not guaranteed. What a %VAR% expands to is not checked here.
